arguments.description: Check git diff scope for ledger
arguments.command: git status --short AUDIT_LEDGER.md; git diff --numstat AUDIT_LEDGER.md; Write-Output '--- additions before my section? ---'; git diff -U0 AUDIT_LEDGER.md | Select-String '^@@' | Select-Object -First 10 | Out-String -Width 200
